title: FROM AMBIGUITY TO VERDICT: A SEMIOTIC-GROUNDED MULTI-PERSPECTIVE AGENT FOR LLM LOGICAL REASONING
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark called RepublicQA, which is specifically grounded in classical philosophical and ethical traditions. It evaluates the logical reasoning capabilities of LLMs on abstract propositions and contextual premises related to justice, morality, virtue, and ethics, drawing heavily from Plato's Republic.
